name: V-Tech Studio Widgets for Elementor
author: Ved Sharma

sections.description:
Elementor widgets for a blog post grid and a WooCommerce product grid. Includes category filtering, pagination, badges, responsive columns, and add to cart for simple and variable products. WooCommerce is required only for the product grid, the cart link, and the account link.

On the V-Tech Studio page, choose a site logo and build a header menu from pages or custom links. In Elementor, add Site Logo, Navigation Menu, Search, Cart, and Account to a header.

Headers and footers are built with Elementor. A header replaces the theme header, and a footer replaces the theme footer, on the views you choose. Other views keep the theme header and footer. Choose the front page, pages, posts, selected IDs, or WooCommerce screens, and set a priority when more than one header or footer matches.
sections.installation:
There are two ways to install this plugin:

  1. Upload manually:

    • Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/v-tech-studio-widgets-for-elementor directory.
    • Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.

  2. Install from WordPress repository:

    • Go to WordPress admin → Plugins → Add New.
    • Search for V-Tech Studio Widgets for Elementor.
    • Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”.

Once activated, edit a page with Elementor and add the “Ved Woo Products Grid Widget” or “Ved Blog Grid” widget.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor Pro?

No, it works with the free version of Elementor.

What versions of Elementor are supported?

This plugin requires Elementor 3.0.0 or higher and has been tested up to Elementor 3.31.3.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

WooCommerce is only required for the Woo Products Grid widget, the Cart and Account widgets, and for WooCommerce header and footer locations.

Where do I set the logo and menu?

Open V-Tech Studio in the dashboard. Select a logo from the media library, create the header menu, and add pages or custom links. Then place the Site Logo and Navigation Menu widgets in a header.

How do I add a header?

Open V-Tech Studio, then Headers. Save a header, design it with Elementor, and choose where it shows. A higher priority is used when two headers match the same page. If the priorities are equal, a specific page beats Entire site. A matching header replaces the theme header. Themes that do not call wp_body_open can use the shortcode [vtechst_header]. The header is printed only once per page.

How do I add a footer?

Open V-Tech Studio, then Footers. Save a footer, design it with Elementor, and choose where it shows. Priority works the same way as headers. A matching footer replaces the theme footer. Themes that do not call wp_footer can use the shortcode [vtechst_footer]. The footer is printed only once per page.

Can I style the widgets for mobile and tablet?

Yes, all style controls are fully responsive.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Choose the site logo and build a header menu on the V-Tech Studio page
  • Add Site Logo, Navigation Menu, Search, Cart, and Account widgets
  • Add post, archive, breadcrumb, and WooCommerce product widgets
  • Add page templates for posts, archives, and WooCommerce views, including an Archive Loop widget
  • Elementor Canvas stays blank. Elementor Full Width and Theme keep the header and footer, including on block themes
  • Preview a real post or product while designing a template
  • Add product rating, stock, sale badge, upsells, and WooCommerce notices, plus a mini cart on the Cart widget
  • Target one post category, tag, or product category, and add Author Box, Site Title, Site Tagline, Copyright, and a footer menu
  • Archive Loop can use columns, the date, a category, a read-more link, and a product sale badge
  • Export one template as a local file and import it again as a draft
  • Show or hide a single widget for logged-in or logged-out visitors
  • Use a custom icon for the V-Tech Studio menu

1.2.0

  • Add an Elementor footer that replaces the theme footer on the views you choose
  • Footers use the same locations, excludes, and priority as headers

1.1.0

  • Add an Elementor header that replaces the theme header on the views you choose
  • Choose entire site, front page, pages, posts, specific IDs, excludes, and WooCommerce screens
  • Set a priority so the higher number is used when more than one header matches

1.0.2

  • Logged-out visitors can view both widgets and add products to the cart
  • Blog posts render in the page instead of waiting on a second request
  • Product filters, sorting, and pagination work without a nonce in the URL
  • Variable product options are passed to the product grid again
  • Product sorting uses WooCommerce’s own product query
  • Widget assets load only when that widget is on the page

1.0.1

  • [Ved Woo Products Grid Widget] Added responsive column controls for desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • [Ved Woo Products Grid Widget] Improved mobile responsiveness for sidebar layouts
  • [Ved Woo Products Grid Widget] Fixed minor CSS issues
  • Added filter bar positioning options (Top/Left/Right)
  • Added admin widget manager to activate/deactivate widgets
  • Fixed price sorting functionality for WooCommerce products
  • Improved widget status persistence and AJAX handling

1.0.0

  • Initial release with WooCommerce products grid and blog grid widgets.
